_comment: Tavern leveling curves, curated from public strategy sources the way hero_tips.json is - written text, not scraped stats. Researched 2026-08-15 against Season 14 (Dark Gifts of Dalaran, patch 36.2.1) from days-old community consensus; contested numbers went to the most recent source. curve maps tavern tier -> the turn to reach it. Heroes are matched by their printable name; a hero in no bucket follows default.

default.label: standard
default.note: T5 by turn 7-8. Trinket turn 7. Tier 6 optional. Below 25 health: stop leveling, build the board.

economy.label: economy
economy.note: Extra gold levels you a beat early - but this bucket is weak this season (gifts and trinkets eat the spare gold).

power1.label: 1-gold power
power1.note: Press the hero power every turn from turn 2; first level waits until turn 4, then levels come back-to-back.

power2.label: 2-gold power
power2.note: Weave the power between levels - every tier lands later than the standard line.

tempo.label: tempo
tempo.note: Stay tier 1 tripling premium 1-drops, then double-level 1 to 3 on turn 5 (sell a minion to afford it).

tank.label: tank / greed
tank.note: Extra effective health licenses the greed line: 3 on 3, 4 on 5. Back off below 25 health like everyone else.

gift.label: dark gifts
gift.note: Xavius gifts are free - level normal or slightly greedy. Tras'tath just needs to reach turn 7 alive.
